* * **
JASJIT SINGH BEDI, J.
On 11.03.2024, the following order was passed:-

"This is petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for issuance of a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the respondents No.1 to 3 to protect the life and liberty of the petitioners from the officials of CIA Staff-II Yamuna Nagar- respondents No.4 who is issuing threats for elimination of life to the present petitioners and also threatened to implicate them in a false FIR and further directing the respondents No.2 and 3 to conduct an inquiry into the conduct of the officials of CIA Staff-II Yamuna Nagar-respondent no.4.

sentences.text: 1 On the asking of the Court, Mr.Kiran Pal Singh, AAG, Haryana accepts notice on behalf of the respondents-State and seeks time to file reply.

1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:087955 Reply, if any, be filed on or before the next date of hearing with a copy in advance to the counsel opposite.
Adjourned to 08.05.2024."
The learned counsel for the respondent-State on instructions from Inspector Anish Kumar, CIA-II,

Nagar , submits that FIR No.236 dated 15.12.2023 under Sections 386, 420, 506 and 120-B IPC, Police Station Jathlana, YamunaNagar was registered against the petitioners who were arrested in the aforesaid FIR and had been granted the concession of bail.
Thereafter, the report under Section 173(2) Cr.P.C. already stands submitted against the petitioners and as such, the custody of the petitioners is not required either in this case or any other case.
In view of the submissions made, no further orders are required to be passed in this case.
The present petition stands disposed of.
